patterns.note: The hero section undergoes a multi-stage transformation on scroll, sequentially revealing new typographic messages and an interactive 3D element.
An asymmetrical, sparse project grid is used, featuring large negative space and minimal details for each entry.
Extreme typographic contrast is employed, with massive, bold display headings dominating the hero and subtle, smaller text for descriptions and navigation.
A strict duotone color scheme of dark green text on an off-white background is maintained across all primary content areas.

technique_notes: The site uses a sophisticated scroll-triggered animation system (likely combining GSAP ScrollTrigger with WebGL/Three.js) to orchestrate a dynamic hero experience. As the user scrolls, initial hero content slides out, new messages slide in, and a large typographic statement appears, accompanied by an interactive 3D object that moves and reacts to the text. The primary navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport.
The overall design emphasizes a minimalist aesthetic with abundant negative space, allowing large, impactful typography and subtle interactive elements to command attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold hero headings (easily 5-6x body text size) with smaller, lighter body and descriptive text.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and project sections, creating a sense of luxury and focus

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, multi-stage hero transformation on scroll, which sequentially reveals different messages and culminates in an interactive 3D element engaging with the typography. This creates a highly memorable and playful yet sophisticated first impression.
